analysis.evidence: וַיְהִי רִיב introduces a quarrel as the next event in the narrative. The paired phrases בֵּין … וּבֵין identify the two parties, Abram’s herders and Lot’s herders.
analysis.morphology: The conjunction וַ is prefixed to יְהִי, the shortened Qal wayyiqtol form, third person masculine singular. The verb agrees with רִיב, “a quarrel.”
